record.one_liner: PitchBook is a subscription database of private and public capital markets data (companies, deals, investors, funds) delivered via a web platform, data feeds and an API (Direct Data).
record.auth_notes: Static API key sent as `Authorization: PB-Token <key>`, per a third-party (Frontegg) connector page; not verified on PitchBook's own docs (pitchbook.com returned 403). No OAuth flow for third-party apps found. The MCP connector uses a separate sign-in (method not stated on the fetched page).
record.access_notes: Search snippets of PitchBook's help page say the Direct Data team provisions the key and existing customers start the request from Plugins & Apps in the platform. This implies a paid subscription plus a Direct Data entitlement, with no self-serve signup. The endpoint reference is reportedly behind platform login. I could not fetch the official page (403), so this is unverified by fetch.
record.blocker: No self-serve API access. Direct Data requires a PitchBook subscription and provisioning by PitchBook, with API docs behind login. The official MCP server (Premium) is available only to PitchBook clients.

evidence.auth: https://developers.frontegg.com/agen-for-work/connectors/marketplace/pitchbook.md (third-party; states static API key, Authorization: PB-Token header, no OAuth)
evidence.mcp: https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/pitchbook (publisher PitchBook, verified badge, URL https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp, 24 tools, for PitchBook clients)
